title: Super Mario All-Stars: Super Mario Bros - Piranha Plant Pack
description:
Made for C3 Summer 2022.

This graphic pack includes not only SMAS-SMB Sprite graphics for the piranha plant but also includes some custom graphics and edits for the selection of compatible custom sprites in the sprite section.


Compatible Normal Sprites
Jumping Piranha Plants
Classic Piranha Plant (Unused in Super Mario World)
Upside-down Piranha Plant


Compatible Custom Sprites
Jumping Piranha Plant Plus - https://www.smwcentral.net/?p=section&a=details&id=26936
Piranha Plants and Venus Fire Traps v1.1 - https://www.smwcentral.net/?p=section&a=details&id=24223
Custom Venus Fire Trap Pack - https://www.smwcentral.net/?p=section&a=details&id=3638
SMB3 Ptooie - https://www.smwcentral.net/?p=section&a=details&id=16134
Fire Stalking Piranha Plant - https://www.smwcentral.net/?p=section&a=details&id=25311
Venus Flyin' Trap - https://www.smwcentral.net/?p=section&a=details&id=16257
Giant Piranha Plants - https://www.smwcentral.net/?p=section&a=details&id=3189
Giant Jumping Piranha Plant - https://www.smwcentral.net/?p=section&a=details&id=23761

If you want to get the normal piranha plant sprites palette to be the same as the one from the original game then change the piranha's head palette ID to D and for stem change the palette ID for that to A in STEAR below.

STEAR
https://www.smwcentral.net/?p=section&a=details&id=14987

if you want to get the custom piranha plant sprites palette listed above to be the same as the one from the original game then change it in the CFG editor or the ASM file.
